calls.title: Mike Hartington and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The company is experiencing significant growth, having more than doubled its revenue through key client wins and an expanding sales team, strategically positioning itself in a developer-centric market post-competitor acquisitions. Leadership recognizes a strong product-market fit, with an emphasis on developer-first experimentation and rapid feature development driven by partnerships like Anthropic. The culture encourages meritocracy and cross-functional collaboration, valuing versatile individuals who can blend technical skills with community engagement. Mike Hartington's background in product launches and developer relations aligns well with the role’s expectations. Next steps include reviewing candidate materials and assessing fit for the role's technical and strategic responsibilities.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, DevRel, developer tools, product marketing, experimentation, AI coding
